entry_points.text: Audit lifecycle. Context moves idle to syscall or op and back, teardown detaches. Entry expects idle with no pending names, ignored when off/stateless/disabled; exit expects syscall-marked non-placeholder and always clears. Teardown flushes trees, refilters, emits and frees. Restart codes map to interrupted except one ioctl code; validity marks success/failure. Busy entry or pending names warn and panic; unexpected exit traps.

Op nesting in syscalls. Op entry inside active syscall only stores op code; nested exit emits just the op record leaving outer event, otherwise full handling and reset. Exit emits ordered summary, aux, identity, names and terminator. Log-start failures skip silently except sticky security/identity errors that panic after terminator.

KDB entry. Setup captures CPU, stopped task and regs and always succeeds; teardown clears them. Parse enforces line/arg limits, returns success/denied/unknown/control; empty or interrupt-cleared input succeeds silently. Supports quoting, escaping, comments, filters, abbreviations and repeat/dash control.

exports.text: Syscall and operation hooks. Entry captures identity, args and timestamp and marks context; exit normalizes result, refilters, emits when required and resets. Disabled and placeholder contexts skip work; fields rely on per-task serialization without explicit lock.

Filesystem, queue, IPC and socket capture. Attaches names, snapshots inode attrs/caps, correlates parent/child reusing on match else anonymous with child reusing parent ref or marking unset, delegates files, stashes queue flags/mode/attrs, IPC ownership and socket data with fd pairs and addresses; idle is no-op with validation.

Queue notify/attrs, IPC perm proposals, exec counts, mappings, extended open, ptrace identities, capability transitions with version and old/new sets plus root, and time data. Absent inputs normalize to zero; injected offsets never override set category while changed network-time overwrites it.

Direct emitters for module, fanotify, netfilter, dumps, seccomp and task identity with response/signal/arch/config attrs; one dump case and disabled paths skip. Trust is negative/affirmative/indeterminate defaulting indeterminate; alloc failures and null buffers return quietly with module loss via lost path.

Debugger hooks plus GDB loop. Hooks install/remove breakpoints with preserve/patch, read PC, init, skip exceptions, handle NMIs and round up CPUs, validating by trial install/remove. Session consumes one stopped CPU, announces stop when connected, then dialogues until arch resume or detach.

Shared debugger state: connection, IO ops, active CPU, breakpoint flag, thread/use/continue selection, step flag/process, per-CPU info, sstep pid, IO-module flag, early mode, switch target and frontend mode. Starts early and interactive with quiescent indicators.

hazards.text: NMI and stall safety. NMI entry clears flag and enters as subordinate only during active master session when not already inside, skipping initiator and in-progress CPUs with flagging and clearing on immediate failure. Debug entry jointly refreshes softlockup, clocksource and RCU detectors via CPU-local writes.

invariants.text: Name and title rendering. Prefers explicit path, else stored name with full/empty/prefix handling, else cwd or null; inode attrs only when captured; type label plus capabilities always close. Count tracks membership. Alloc reuses embedded pool then dynamic with ownership flag; modes are GFP_KERNEL/ATOMIC/NOFS with bounded title and revision-decoded caps.

Roundup, reboot and coordination defaults. Peer notification enabled but boot option can disable it; reboot, console and break-request start quiescent with zeroed master/slave counters. Logs use fixed KGDB prefix.

GDB framing and thread identity. Waits for open marker, buffers to bound until close, validates hex checksum with ack/nak to agreement, marks connected with exclusive buffers. Errors use fixed-width magnitude. Thread refs are big-endian with suppressed zeros; zero pids map to per-CPU shadows; resolution covers 0/-1, per-CPU range and positive pids via init namespace under RCU.

Register access. Prefers stopped-CPU arch state on thread match, else synthesizes from scheduler state via per-register sizes. Whole-read refreshes and hex-encodes; foreign-thread writes fail; single-register validates against arch max before touching stopped-CPU block.

Memory transfer. Hex codecs use intermediate buffers with fault-safe access; faults and malformed encodings report invalid argument and foreign updates are refused. Reads/writes carry hex address/length; binary writes unescape in place; successful writes request icache coherence when safe; hex integers accept negation with digit count.

Queries, detach and readiness. Current-thread uses shadow mapping; lists emit per-CPU shadows then process threads with paged bounded batches; extra-info names threads or synthesizes CPU labels. Status clears breakpoints before reporting stop; detach clears and disconnects (kill without ack), losing breakpoints; reboot only for R0. IO ready negative only with no ops.

Fallback and permissions. Without full dispatch exceptions pass through. Evaluation grants always-safe ops, masks caller perms to enable set and augments argless calls before intersecting requirements.

locks.text: Tree and filter scans use read-side protection. Inode and ancestry walks check membership under protection; fstype scans filter list under protection; ancestry samples rename sequence and retries on rename or growth, rolling back partial refs and forcing retention when out of space.

state_machines.text: Registration uses dedicated spinlock with exception tracking. Breakpoints move between set and active under passes skipping other states with safe-only icache refresh, reporting failures while continuing. CPU entry elects one master under exclusion with interrupts off that quiets peers, loops with toggle or handoff, then restores breakpoints, hardware and tracing; bounded peer wait may proceed with severe notice.

structs.text: Audit ABI: AUDIT_PATH/PROCTITLE/URINGOP/SYSCALL/BPRM_FCAPS/FD_PAIR/SOCKADDR/CWD/EOE/MQ_OPEN; AUDIT_CTX_UNUSED/SYSCALL/URING; AUDIT_STATE_DISABLED/BUILD/RECORD; AUDITSC_INVALID/SUCCESS/FAILURE; AUDIT_NAME_FULL/INO_UNSET/NAMES with TYPE_UNKNOWN/NORMAL/PARENT/CHILD_CREATE/CHILD_DELETE, INODE_PARENT/HIDDEN/NOEVAL, FILTER_FS/FSTYPE/NEVER; PER_LINUX personality.
